home.meta: Rao (เรา): a private space for two. One small question a day, sealed letters that open when you both write, postcards and your dates. Thai and English.
home.how_sub: Five minutes a day. No feed, no likes, no strangers.
home.step1_body: Sign up and create a space for the two of you. Send your person the invite link or code (it works once, for 7 days).
home.step2_body: Every day brings one small question. On weekends it's a little quest to do together, or apart.
home.step3_body: Write your letter and press the wax seal. Your partner can't read it yet, and you can't read theirs.
home.step4_body: When you've both written, the letters open side by side. Write back underneath if you like.
home.step5_body: Every day you both write becomes a stamp on your calendar. Busy week? You get 2 rest days a week that don't break the streak.
home.more_sub: Small things that help you stay close.
home.f_moments_body: Share a photo or a few words from a good day. React and comment, just the two of you.
home.f_dates_body: Anniversary, birthdays and special days, with a reminder the day before. Postcards come back as memories every year.
home.f_mood_body: One tap to say how you are, so your partner knows before they ask.
home.f_ld_body: Far apart? See the distance and each other's local time, with questions made for couples who are apart.
home.f_nudge_body: Sealed yours? Send one soft reminder a day. Notifications never show private words on the lock screen.
home.f_themes_body: Pick a theme you like: dusk, daytime, night or doodle. Your partner picks their own.
home.private_body: Nobody else can see your space: not other people, and not us. There are no ads and nothing is sold. Download everything you wrote, or delete your account, whenever you want.
home.private_2: Your exact location is never saved
home.private_3: Download or delete your data any time
home.install_title: Put it on your home screen
home.install_body: Rao works in the browser, and feels like an app once it's on your home screen (needed on iPhone for notifications).
home.install_ios: iPhone: open in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen
home.install_android: Android: open in Chrome → menu ⋮ → Install app
home.faq1_a: It's free during the beta. If we ever add paid extras, we'll publish the prices first and never charge you without asking.
home.faq2_q: Does my partner need an account?
home.faq2_a: Yes, each of you has your own account, so your letters stay yours. Your partner joins with your invite link.
home.faq3_q: Can my partner read my letter before writing theirs?
home.faq3_a: No. Letters only open when you've both written. That's the whole idea.
home.faq4_q: What if we miss a day?
home.faq4_a: Nothing bad happens. You can still answer a missed day later, and 2 rest days a week keep your streak.
home.faq5_q: Can I change what I wrote?
home.faq5_a: Yes, until your partner writes theirs and both letters open. After that it's locked, like a letter that's been delivered.
home.faq6_a: Thai and English. You each choose your own, and every question comes in both.
home.cta_body: It takes a minute to set up.
